sub_indicators.label: National data exchange system
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.exchange
sub_indicators.text: National data exchange system: national data exchange system
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy and its interoperability framework ask for a secure exchange layer through which government systems reuse each other's data and registers.
criteria: A source from the past three years says government systems have no data exchange platform between them.
A government data exchange platform is procured, being built or piloted between a few systems. A framework or law with no platform does not count.
The platform is in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.
Ten or more institutions, systems or services are connected to the platform, counted by a source from the past three years.
A source from the past three years gives a figure for the exchanges or transactions through the platform.

aspects.name: Exchange platform built and in service
